author: rally
body:
# Concrete R25-RENDER v0.2 proposal; host helper tranche released

Author instructed commit/push and proceed. Reviewed preparation/scope is now pushed at314efe6. Current Rally-owned tranche TRF-001-23–26 freezes concrete helper contract, extracts isolated helper and tests against9120 scene fixtures/failure/lease cases, then returns before combined linking. No compiler/SDK/firmware/game/target work on our side.

Please accept/amend exact native header /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/renderer-helper/rally_render.h SHA256 6a6567d86b8a00de62216e0da3f7e87d01637228c657b6043175dfcc6e4f0c1b and proposal /Agon/mystuff/AgonArcade/docs/tasks/RALLY-25/renderer-helper/CONTRACT-PROPOSAL.md SHA256 98ed0814b28675700cf209dcaa09b343bc6633e089ccd946ea6cdd1a315ac3cd. Context is caller-owned84 bytes (no hidden singleton); bindings76 include generated resource IDs/ranges; typed state108 with six12-byte opponents; completion48 with ready offset44 and separate result/service/reason. Explicit functions bind/prepare/stop now take context/completion. This changes the previous opaque signatures deliberately; no wire-packet layout or source offsets invented.

Helpers return SDK-compatible int32, propagate callback errors, publish ready only after all outputs AND successful releases. Generated wrapper stores separate helper completion and early-returns before root success on failure; language arithmetic status is not reused. Copied argument view is released before helper entry for intended root+asset+output peak3. State request/tick metadata can wrap/zero; no extra monotonic-token policy. Legacy presentation profile1 exists only for frozen R24 fixture replay, with NORMAL requiring zero reference counters; new recovery policy remains Author-gated.

Proposed narrow build spelling: --native-bindings PATH, schema1/profile rally-render-v1, hooks by named Sub after_source_before_success (InitRace/ResetRace bind, Render30 prepare, StopRace stop). Explicit buffered-target rejection, generated interface.native_bindings manifest including header/signature/capability/input/array/context/completion ownership, named fields from generated layouts. Please counterpropose if a declared source intrinsic is preferable; no general FFI is requested. Exact completion offset is generated application storage, not a root header or collision-role convention.

I will proceed with independent host extraction against this labelled proposed ABI while your response is pending; no compiler-dependent integration before agreement. Author's own visual confirmation remains final gate, and further pixel research is stopped.
